Subject: Exec retreat - handoff playbook and notes distribution

Hi all,

Thanks again for hosting the leadership day yesterday — great discussions and very constructive alignment on the roadmap and procurement timeline. I’ve attached the workshop notes and a draft mutual action plan (MAP_v2.xlsx) that consolidates the commitments we captured.

This thread is to lock down the post-onsite handoff responsibilities and the distribution plan for the exec packet. Proposed plan:

- Consolidate notes + exec one-pager (Slide_Exec_Summary.pptx) and send to Novus execs by Tuesday 11/23 10:00am PT.
- Update HubSpot deal record (HubSpot: 12345) with action owners and dates.
- Create engineering tickets for the three technical follow-ups and attach the relevant note snippets.
- Send procurement paperwork (SOW template + pricing) to procurement@novussys.com after legal completes redlines.

Proposed owners (please confirm or reassign):
- Finalize consolidated notes & slides: Monica Patel — due Mon 11/22 EOD
- HubSpot MAP update + deal notes: Monica Patel — due Mon 11/22 EOD
- Technical follow-ups / Jira tickets: Rishi Malhotra & Connor O'Brien — create tickets Mon 11/22, link to INF-987
- Procurement packet + next steps: Evelyn Hart — draft to legal Mon 11/22, send to Novus procurement Tue 11/23 after redlines

Attachments: Novus_Workshop_Notes_20261121.pdf (PDF, 428KB), MAP_v2.xlsx (63KB), Slide_Exec_Summary.pptx (2.1MB).

Ask: everyone please reply with a quick thumbs-up or a new owner by EOD today so we can commit to the Tuesday distribution schedule. If any dates are unrealistic, flag them in your reply and propose an alternate.

Thanks — Ben

Ben — thanks for pulling this together. I can own the consolidation and HubSpot MAP update. A few clarifications:

- I’ll tighten the slide deck to a one-page executive summary + two backup slides. Expect v1 by Mon 11/22 2pm PT.
- For the MAP, I want to split the procurement item into: (a) pricing decision (owner: Novus procurement), (b) SOW redlines (owner: Redwood legal / Evelyn).
- I’ll add a short "ask" blurb at the top of the notes for the Novus execs (clear asks and approvals required).

Two quick asks for Ben/Evelyn: can you provide the approved pricing band we discussed so I can include it in the pack (even as a range)? Also, Evelyn — can you confirm legal availability Monday to run through the SOW redlines?

Thumbs-up from me otherwise.
